title: Citation markers with no citations directive render numbered links to anchors that do not exist
description: A hacking article had [@key] citations but no ::citations{} directive. Papyrus rendered numbered links to anchors that did not exist. Before publication, flag a body with citation markers and no bibliography directive (the story checklist citation check), or supply the bibliography automatically. The standard bibliography also adds direct external links; make the format publication-configurable so a site with an internal-links-only policy (Machines on Machines) can render the bibliography without outbound hyperlinks (title, publisher and date as plain text, or links to the site's own Reference pages). Gherkin: marker without directive is flagged; a configured internal-only bibliography has no external href.
